facts.text: The resort is set on 240 acres within a vast 8,100-acre landscape bordered by the protected lands of the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem.
facts.excerpt: Set on 240 acres within a vast 8,100-acre landscape, One&Only Moonlight Basin is bordered by the protected lands of the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem.

facts.text: In winter the resort offers slopes for snowsports; in the warmer months, hiking, biking and fly-fishing.
facts.excerpt: In winter, discover epic slopes for snowsports; in the warmer months, hiking, biking and fly-fishing await.

facts.text: The architecture and design are by architect Tom Kundig and interact with the landscape.
facts.excerpt: Courtesy of celebrated architect Tom Kundig, One&Only Moonlight Basin’s architecture and design interacts with the epic landscape, without interrupting nature’s rhythms.

facts.text: The resort is flanked by animal habitats, including those of endangered grizzly bears; experiences are expert-led.
facts.excerpt: Our resort is flanked by animal habitats, including those of endangered grizzly bears. Experiences here are expert-led and guests are provided with safety details pre-arrival.

facts.text: Big Sky is around an hour's drive from Bozeman International Airport, and the resort can arrange private transfers.
facts.excerpt: Big Sky, Montana is around an hour’s drive from Bozeman International Airport, served by a variety of airlines. Our Connectivity Team can arrange private transfers.

facts.text: Dogs are welcome, with a limit of two dogs per booking.
facts.excerpt: Dogs are welcome at One&Only Moonlight Basin, with a limit of two dogs per booking

facts.text: All transfers are subject to weather conditions and may be delayed or rescheduled in adverse weather.
facts.excerpt: All transfer options are subject to weather conditions. In the event of adverse weather, transfers may be delayed or rescheduled.

facts.text: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.

facts.text: The resort was named on Travel + Leisure's Best New US Resorts for 2026 and TIME's World's Greatest Places for 2026.
facts.excerpt: being named on Travel + Leisure’s Best New US Resorts for 2026, and TIME’s World’s Greatest Places for 2026.

facts.text: This is One&Only's first US hotel and the brand's first alpine resort.
facts.excerpt: This is One&Only’s first US hotel and the brand’s first alpine resort.

facts.text: Even the smallest rooms feature a fireplace, a private balcony and bathrooms with soaking tubs and separate showers.
facts.excerpt: Even the smallest of the rooms, which start at 721 square feet, feature a fireplace and private balcony, and bathrooms with soaking tubs and separate showers.

facts.text: The private cabins each have an outdoor deck with a private fire pit and hot tub.
facts.excerpt: The private cabins each have an outdoor deck with a private fire pit and hot tub.

facts.text: The spa includes an indoor-outdoor lap pool, heated onsen soaking tub, cold plunge, steam room and sauna.
facts.excerpt: which includes an indoor-outdoor lap pool, heated onsen soaking tub, cold plunge, steam room, and sauna.

facts.text: Akira Back is a restaurant led by Chef Akira Back, known for creative takes on Japanese-Korean fusion.
facts.excerpt: The hotels’ best dishes are served at the latter, led by the eponymous Michelin-starred Chef Akira Back, a celebrity culinary disruptor and ex-professional snowboarder known for his creative takes on Japanese-Korean fusion.

facts.text: Moonshack is a speakeasy-style cabin with live music and poker and a whisky bar.
facts.excerpt: Moonshack, a speakeasy-style cabin with live music and poker, a whisky bar

facts.text: Guests have direct access to Big Sky Mountain via the One&Only Sky Lodge, the hotel's home base for snow sports.
facts.excerpt: Guests have direct access to Big Sky Mountain via the One&Only Sky Lodge, the hotel’s home base for snow sports.

facts.text: From the Sky Lodge, the heated One&Only Gondola runs to the Madison Base area and connects to the rest of the mountain.
facts.excerpt: From the Sky Lodge, you can take the One&Only Gondola to the Madison Base area—a heated 5-minute ride that then connects you to the rest of the mountain.

facts.text: On-site trails are open for snowshoeing, fat tire biking and cross-country Nordic skiing.
facts.excerpt: explore the 15 miles of trails (most of which are groomed daily) onsite that are open for snowshoeing, fat tire biking, and cross-country Nordic skiing.

facts.text: Every guest, no matter their room category, is paired with an on-property host.
facts.excerpt: every guest, no matter their room category, is paired with an on-property “host”

facts.text: The hotel has a private observatory where a local astronomer can lead stargazing sessions on request.
facts.excerpt: the hotel’s private observatory, where a local astronomer can lead stargazing sessions for guests upon request.

facts.text: The KidsOnly club offers outdoor programming for children.
facts.excerpt: the “KidsOnly club” offers special outdoor programming for young adventurers.

facts.text: Half of the hotel's rooms can be connected to other rooms to form a family suite.
facts.excerpt: Half of the hotel’s rooms were designed so they can be connected to other rooms to form a family suite.

facts.text: There is a tennis court and an outdoor yoga deck just outside the spa.
facts.excerpt: there’s a tennis court and outdoor yoga deck just outside.

facts.text: Wildlife including moose, elk and bears moves through the surrounding landscape, a critical migration route.
facts.excerpt: the landscape provides critical migration routes for species like elk, mule deer, bears, moose, and bobcats

contradictions.note: p1 says 8,100-acre landscape, p2 says 8,000-acre community
